claim: The Court reversed a Fifth Circuit grant of immunity to officials who confined an inmate in a cell covered in feces for six days.
evidence: The case involved a suit for alleged violation of Taylor’s Eighth Amendment rights by corrections officers who forced him to inhabit horrifically unsanitary cells in a prison psychiatric unit for a total of six days.
